mapper.update: UPDATE connector_bindings SET tenant_id = #{tenantId}, external_user_id = #{externalUserId}, user_id = #{userId}, organization_id = #{organizationId}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM connector_bindings WHERE channel = #{channel} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, channel, external_chat_id, conversation_id, binding_id, created_at, updated_at FROM connector_threads WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE connector_threads SET conversation_id = #{conversationId}, binding_id = #{bindingId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: UPDATE connector_inbox SET status = 'processing', attempts = attempts + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = ( SELECT id FROM connector_inbox WHERE attempts < #{maxAttempts} AND ( (status IN ('pending', 'failed') AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= now())) OR (status = 'processing' AND updated_at < now() - interval '2 minutes') ) ORDER BY created_at ASC FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) RETURNING id, channel, event_id, payload, status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE connector_inbox SET status = 'processing', attempts = attempts + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('pending', 'failed')
